title: fix(app-shell): Studio's flow definition switch keeps keyboard focus across a toggle
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb7bgo9GLavj5QghibLqpzHe)_

Fixes #29376

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The two lines are copied from the claim (comment 6579229963).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio › Automations 里可写包流程的「启用/停用」开关（流程定义开关，`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`），保存进行中不再是 `disabled`，改为 `aria-disabled`，并在点击处理里拒绝再次按下；只读包、没有画布的情况仍是 `disabled`，说明文字不变。
- 为什么改：浏览器会把焦点从一个变成 `disabled` 的已聚焦控件挪到页面 body，保存结束后也不会还回来。用键盘或读屏的作者每拨一次开关（保存成功或被拒都一样），都得从页面顶部重新 Tab 回来。这与 #29228（PR #29375）修过的部署开关是同一个缺陷，本 PR 用同样的做法。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个开关的 `onClick` / `disabled` / `aria-disabled` 三处属性和一个样式类；请求中视觉上仍是半透明（`aria-disabled:opacity-50`）。保存中按第二次空格不会再发保存，由点击守卫保证（测试与消融都钉住了）。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 里定义开关的 `inert` / `busy` 两行和 `onClick`；新测试文件 `StudioDesignSurface.definitionSwitchFocus-29376.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.definitionSwitchFocus-29376.test.tsx`，预期 3 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the flow definition switch only: while a save is in flight (`saving`), the switch carries `aria-disabled="true"` instead of `disabled`, and its `onClick` refuses the press while `saving`. `disabled` stays for the two cases where the switch cannot be flipped at all (no canvas to edit, or a read-only package), so a read-only switch is unchanged: disabled, out of the tab order, described by the package's reason through its focusable wrapper. The in-flight dimming adds `aria-disabled:opacity-50` beside `disabled:opacity-50`, so the switch looks as before.
- A comment at the switch says why the busy state is `aria-disabled`.
- `toggleEnabled` is not touched; the guard sits in the switch's handler, as in PR #29375.

## Why

Measured live by the #29228 os-dev in Chromium 153 on a fresh showcase (a scratch writable package with one flow): with the definition switch focused, Space saved the draft (`PUT 200`) and `document.activeElement` was the page body afterwards. The switch drew `disabled={!isEditable || !!saving || readOnly}`, and `toggleEnabled` sets `saving = 'draft'`. A focused control that turns `disabled` loses focus and nothing returns it. Same shape as #29228; this applies PR #29375's approach (focus never leaves, so there is nothing to restore and no host plumbing).

## Tests

New file `StudioDesignSurface.definitionSwitchFocus-29376.test.tsx`, on the harness of `StudioDesignSurface.automationsReadOnly-11124` (the real `FlowPreview` and `FlowInspector`, a client double whose draft save is held on a gate and can be refused with `ITEM_LOCKED`):

- `it.each` over a saved flip and a refused one: focus the switch, press Space with `@testing-library/user-event`. In flight, `document.activeElement` is the switch, it is `aria-disabled="true"` and still enabled; a second Space leaves the switch on the first flip (`aria-checked="false"`) and the save count at 1. After the answer (off when saved; the refusal shown and back on when refused), the switch is the same element, `document.activeElement` is still the switch, and the save count is still 1.
- Read-only package: the switch is `disabled`, carries no `aria-disabled`, is described by the read-only reason, and cannot take focus.
- **Why the test runs a focus fixup.** happy-dom keeps focus on a control that turns `disabled`; a browser does not. `runFocusFixup` (copied from PR #29375's test) moves focus to the body when the focused switch turns disabled, so the focus pins can fail.
- **Why the second press is pinned by state, not only by count.** Draft saves are queued one at a time (`useDraftSaveGuard`), so a second save waits behind the held one and the server count alone cannot see it in flight. The first draft of this test checked only the count and the guard ablation went red later than intended (at the post-answer `aria-checked`); the test now pins the switch's state right after the second Space.
- Ablation 1, the card's: `disabled={inert}` to `disabled={inert || !!saving}` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor x1 to x0, blob ef4c4368 to 987c0f3b): both flip cases red at `expect(document.activeElement).toBe(sw)` in flight (line 190, received the body), read-only case green. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2, the guard: `if (!saving) void toggleEnabled();` to `if (true) void toggleEnabled();` (blob ef4c4368 to 4e50f0fd): both flip cases red at the in-flight `aria-checked` pin (line 198). Restored, same proof.

## Acceptance notes

- A live re-run of the #29228 probe on a fresh showcase was not done (the card calls it welcome, not owed); the evidence is the happy-dom pins with the browser focus fixup, and the two ablations.
- The guard reads `saving`, which every save in this pillar sets (the autosave and publish too), so the switch also refuses a press while an autosave is in flight; before, it was `disabled` then, so nothing new is refused.
